text_ar: إِنَّمَا الأَعْمَالُ بِالنِّيَّاتِ، وَإِنَّمَا لِكُلِّ امْرِئٍ مَا نَوَى
text_en: Actions are only by intentions, and every person shall have only what they intended.

text_ar: يَسِّرُوا وَلَا تُعَسِّرُوا، وَبَشِّرُوا وَلَا تُنَفِّرُوا
text_en: Make things easy and do not make them difficult; give glad tidings and do not drive people away.
